objects.name: Herdmaster Dhal
objects.greeting: The herd goes where the grass goes. We go where the herd goes.
objects.topics: The Khorigale=Horns for pride, a tail for balance, and a wagon for everything else.; The east=The road east runs out of the Vale at the gate. We came in by it. It was quieter then.

objects.name: Sef the Tinker
objects.greeting: If it ticks, I can mend it. If it does not tick, I can make it.

objects.name: Khorigale drover
objects.greeting: Mind the bulls. They mind you.

objects.title: Thunder on the plain
objects.offer: Two old bulls have turned on the herd, north-east of the camp. They must come down before they gore another calf. I will not ask my drovers - will you?
objects.remind: The bulls keep to the north-east, where the grass is tall.
objects.thanks: It had to be done. Drink to them with this - they were fine beasts once.
objects.reward: coins x90, drinking horn x1, leather x6
